title: Carve decision trace, version 1
description: One JSON value per line. The first line is the header; every later line is one block or inline decision record. See docs/decision-trace.md.

engine.description: Who produced the trace: spec-model, carve-js, carve-php, carve-rs or another engine name.

containerPath.description: Open containers from the document down, each as <kind>:<1-based line that opened it>.

step.description: PART 0 step that decided the line (CARVE-P0-024). S3 classification is reported as form.

owner.description: Deepest open container holding the line once the step is applied; for a closer, the container it closes.

rule.description: Normative clause id that governs the decision, or null when none applies.

form.description: What the line is: an S3 classification, or the S1/S4 outcome.

cell.description: FAMILIES cell id of PART 0, when a family entry decided the line.

closed.description: How many open frames the line closed by missing them in S2. A closer's own container is its owner and is not counted.

reached.description: Deepest frame the line reached in S2, when it missed a deeper one.

plus.description: The accepted `+` line this line follows. The walk records the line where it stands; the block readers attach it to that `+`'s container (CARVE-P9-067).

inline.description: Reserved for the inline procedure; its step ids (I1 ...) land when that procedure is normative.

pos.description: Code point offset of the delimiter in the block's inline content.

kind.description: Delimiter kind, for example strong, emphasis, code, link.

pair.description: pos of the matching delimiter, when paired.
